system.description:
You and your allies know the value of keeping soldiers alive and perform as a cohesive healing unit.

Prerequisite: Trained in Treat Injury

Effect: You gain a +3 competence bonus on Treat Injury checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this Feat, the competence bonus increases by +1 (to a maximum of +7).

Additionally, when you use the Aid Another Action to assist an ally who has this Feat with a Treat Injury check to restore Hit Points, your ally restores an extra 4 Hit Points to the target.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy at War
